notablePrerequisites: Skitterbeam Batallion in hand.You control at least nine artifacts.
description:
Cast Skitterbeam Batallion by paying {0}.
Skitterbeam Batallion enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Skitterbeam Batallion tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Skitterbeam Batallion from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
